# HausPower

> HausPower (formerly SmartHaus) is an ECRA/ESA Licensed Electrical Contractor in Ontario, Canada (ECRA #7018055), led by licensed master electrician Matt Allen. It provides residential and commercial electrical work in Toronto, Mississauga, Oakville, Kitchener and Waterloo. Smart home technology is delivered through partners.

- Phone: (519) 635-2078
- Email: hello@hauspower.ca
- Base: Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hauspower.ca/

- [Home](https://hauspower.ca/): overview, disciplines, process, client reviews

- [Safety & Standards](https://hauspower.ca/safety-standards): ECRA/ESA licensing, the ESA notification and inspection process, eight site safety protocols

- [Request a Quote](https://hauspower.ca/request-a-quote): quote form, phone and email

## Services

- Renovations, additions and custom home wiring
- Panel and service changes
- Generator installations
- Lighting controls, interior and exterior
- Motorized shade wiring
- Commercial electrical
- Smart home, security and AV through technology partners
- Collaboration with architects, interior designers and builders
